_doc: Đợt 2 rương Nhật Bản: tiếng bay và tiếng chém của katana. Chạy: python3 -I Tools/Audio/make_elevenlabs_chest_sfx.py --manifest Tools/Audio/manifests/chest_nhat_ban.json

items.prompt: a steel katana spinning slowly through the air, soft rhythmic airy whoosh-whoosh swells of the blade cutting wind, a faint thin metallic shimmer ringing in the background, ending with a gentle rising whoosh, no music

instant sharp katana slash at the very start: a fast hard swoosh with a crisp bright metallic shing ring, then a short pause and the blade sliding back into a wooden scabbard ending with a clean soft click, no music
